warnings: Senior/super-senior rates are NOTE-based premiums (not separate columns) and were captured this run via image OCR of the Hindi rate card. Senior Citizen (वरिष्ठ नागरिक, 60 yrs+): +0.50% over regular for deposits of 6 months (06 माह) and above. Super Senior Citizen (अति वरिष्ठ नागरिक, 80 yrs+): +0.65% over regular for deposits of 2 years (02 वर्ष) and above. Applied accordingly: senior premium only where tenure_min_days >= 180; super-senior premium only where tenure_min_days >= 730. Slabs under 6 months keep rate_senior_pct null; slabs under 2 years keep rate_super_senior_pct null.

Rate card is an image-based PDF (inner-pages/ROI for Website.pdf, 0 extractable text via pdftotext). Rendered to PNG via PyMuPDF and read visually (no tesseract/pdftoppm/Azure Doc Intelligence available locally this run). Effective date 20 April 2026 read from card body (circular Prakra/2026-27/11 dated 18.04.2026; rates w.e.f. दिनांक 20 अप्रैल 2026) — corrected from prior file's 2026-05-25 page-header date.

Card has two amount columns: below Rs 1 crore (used here as below_3cr retail) and Rs 1cr to <10cr (not captured in this regular variant). General rates for the below-1cr column match the prior extraction.
Tenure labels translated from Hindi (दिन=days, वर्ष=year).
